statements.status_notes: Upstream rsync commit a7404a9a633cff28ee1602f328b9c3fa69cdbd04 (released in rsync 3.5.2) is applied to this package's Debian rsync 3.5.0+ds1 source. It bounds the hash_search() collision work in the delta-transfer sender, which is the code path behind CVE-2026-119741. See https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-119741 and https://github.com/RsyncProject/rsync/commit/a7404a9a633cff28ee1602f328b9c3fa69cdbd04.

Upstream rsync commit a7404a9a633cff28ee1602f328b9c3fa69cdbd04 (released in rsync 3.5.2) is applied to this package's Debian rsync 3.5.0+ds1 source. It bounds the hash_search() collision work in the delta-transfer sender, which is the code path behind CVE-2026-119741. See https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-119741 and https://github.com/RsyncProject/rsync/commit/a7404a9a633cff28ee1602f328b9c3fa69cdbd04.
Marked no-dsa by Debian Security Team; see https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-119741

CVE-2026-44510 was rejected as a duplicate of CVE-2026-43620 (see https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-44510). The issue addressed by CVE-2026-43620 was fixed in upstream rsync 3.4.3. This package ships Debian rsync 3.5.0+ds1 (upstream 3.5.0), which includes that fix.

CVE-2026-44509 was rejected as a duplicate of CVE-2026-43619 (see https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-44509). The symlink race in path-based syscalls was fixed in upstream rsync 3.4.3. This package ships Debian rsync 3.5.0+ds1 (upstream 3.5.0), which includes that fix.

CVE-2026-44508 was rejected as a duplicate of CVE-2026-43618 (see https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-44508). The compressed-token decoder overflow was fixed in upstream rsync 3.4.3. This package ships Debian rsync 3.5.0+ds1 (upstream 3.5.0), which includes that fix.

CVE-2026-44507 was rejected as a duplicate of CVE-2026-43617 (see https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-44507). The hostname-based ACL bypass in daemon chroot configuration was fixed in upstream rsync 3.4.3. This package ships Debian rsync 3.5.0+ds1 (upstream 3.5.0), which includes that fix.
